user.title: Configure RideLog
user.description: Enter the URL of your RideLog server — the web interface one (port 3100 by default), not the backend one — and the HA_INIT_KEY defined in RideLog's .env file.

error.cannot_connect: Server unreachable. Check the URL, and that Home Assistant can reach that machine.
error.wrong_url: Something answers at this address, but it is not the RideLog API. Use the web interface URL (port 3100 by default), not the backend one.
error.invalid_auth: Initialisation key rejected. Check HA_INIT_KEY, and that the Home Assistant integration is enabled in RideLog (Settings → Integrations).
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before retrying.
error.not_configured: HA_INIT_KEY is not set on the RideLog server. Add it to its .env file, then restart the backend.
